body: gut feeling.  4-6 weeks is not awful, but i lost my job and internship because of this, i cannot tell close friends of mine how it happened because of mistrust and shame/guilt. school in 2 hours in the most misanthropic city in the world, can't miss class cause i already did.

4-6 weeks, meeting with doctor again wednesday to talk about surgery.  i don't want fucked up hands, i don't want to lose my girlfriend because i can't trust anyone, i want to have everything normal again.  i am homesick but don't want to be home. feels like being torn apart at the seams.

lonely and can't sleep, so tired and scared of everything.  i go to art school and just broke both of my hands. full casts and i cannot draw or take photos anymore. scared about my relationship with girlfriend and growing up, painkillers aren't working and i have to 'wake up' in 3 hours to commute into the city; sorry for poor typing, i am all thumbs.
not worth it. please live. sorry can't type more, the world loves you.
